text:
ben: heads-up — starting the 16:00 UTC change window for canary rollout of service-api v2.4.1. Plan: 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. pin config: `service-api:2.4.1-release-candidate`

aisha: oncall here, i'll watch p95 / 5xx and error budget. will flag if p95 > 800ms or 5xx rate > 0.8% in the first 10m :eyes:

marta: enabling 50% trace sampling for the canary namespace and turning on request-level logs for embed.* routes.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: service-api v2.4.1 -> canary 20% (hosts: 6). ETA to next step ~8m. CI: ✅ smoke, ✅ schema migration dry-run.

obs-bot: alert: increased 5xx for route `/v1/embed` — 0.95% in last 2m (threshold 0.5%). Source: edge-proxy-psi-02. Probe: 16:02 UTC.

samir: seeing same on traces — elevated latency around embed backend pool, likely saturation on gpu-proxy-03. tagging infra.

aisha: hold criteria: pause rollout if p95 >= 800ms OR 5xx >= 1% sustained for 3m. recommend immediate hold at 20% until we confirm root cause.

ben: pausing at 20% now. can someone triage the embed backend? if it's a capacity issue we can route embed traffic to fallback pool and continue.

marta: checking logs — queue depth spiking on gpu-proxy-03, many `worker_timeout` entries. running `kubectl logs --since=10m -l app=gpu-proxy -n prod | grep worker_timeout` to collect.

samir: quick mitigation: pin embed-route to older model variant `embed-1.9-stable` via routing rule for canary users. command:
```
redwood route update --route /v1/embed --force-target embed-1.9-stable --selector=canary
```
Applying that for canary only now.

deploy-bot: Rollout PAUSED at 20% by ben (manual). Reason: 5xx spike on /v1/embed. Timestamp 16:06 UTC.

obs-bot: datapoint: after pinning, /v1/embed 5xx dropped to 0.25% in next 90s — provisional improvement.

aisha: nice. leave canary paused for another 10m to watch stability. if stable, proceed to 50% with same pin; we can unpin later in a targeted follow-up.

ben: noted. updating release notes: added entry under v2.4.1 "temporary routing pin for embed route during rollout" and flagged under ops -> rollback-plan. link: https://confluence.redwood/v2.4.1/releases

marta: collecting trace examples for postmortem and adding to the changelog. also creating a quick runbook note: `if gpu-proxy queue depth > 80% -> pin embed route -> scale gpu-proxy replicas`.

samir: infra will scale gpu-proxy pool by +2 replicas precautionary (initiated). monitor CPU/GPU mem.

aisha: once 15m without regression, we can resume at 50% with watcher on. decision window starts 16:16 UTC.

ben: agreed. moving to watch mode. thanks all — cc @product for release-note heads-up. will update thread when we unpause or roll back.

deploy-bot: Watch mode enabled. Next automated step cancelled until manual resume. Logs for this run archived at s3://redwood-deploys/1717654321/

obs-bot: final note (16:19 UTC): no additional 5xx after pin; p95 for service-api overall steady at 320ms. Proceeding to resume recommended.

ben: resuming to 50% at 16:20 UTC. keeping pin on embed-route until end of change window. rolling metrics: will monitor and call rollback if thresholds breach.

aisha: monitoring — i'm on-call until 18:00 UTC, ping me with :rotating_light: if anything spikes.

marta: will follow up with short post-deploy blameless note and add the temporary routing change to the rollback checklist.

ben: closing the thread for now — rollout continued to 100% at 16:48 UTC with pin still active; follow-up ticket created for unpin and capacity improvements. ticket: #INC-4821
